topic.source_contract: Local Air Quality Management, AQMAs and action-plan evidence

facts.guard: framework status is not a parcel measurement
AQMA designation is not planning refusal or personal exposure
policy guidance is not an AQAP delivery result

facts.directions: annual status reports and action-plan duties
facts.guard: reporting duty is not compliance evidence for a site
national trajectory is not local concentration or planning outcome

scope_guards: AQMA designation identifies objective-exceedance risk and is not a parcel health outcome.
AQMA boundaries, monitoring sites and model grids remain distinct.
An Air Quality Action Plan is a programme of measures and not completed delivery.
Annual Status Reports describe local-authority evidence and are not site-specific assessments.
National PM2.5 targets and trajectories are not candidate-level concentrations.
Air-quality planning assessment must match the proposal, receptors, baseline, traffic and mitigation.
AQMA presence or absence is not planning permission, automatic refusal or title evidence.
No score or promotion is written without exact current AQMA, monitoring/model, proposal and planning evidence.
